shots.text: But on the evidence so far, Breunig says, highly accomplished art does not necessarily require a complex society.
shots.credit: Nok kneeling figure · Honolulu Museum of Art (8348.1) · Photo: Hiart, CC0

shots.desc: overgrown trench, weeds, collapsed string lines

shots.text: Fieldwork stopped after a deadly attack in 2017; the team has not gone back to the excavation area.
shots.desc: an empty field camp at dusk, folded chairs

shots.text: Why Nok ended is still unknown; the team suggests environmental change as one possibility.
shots.desc: storm light moving across the plateau

shots.text: Gabriele Franke puts it this way.
shots.desc: plateau at last light (NOK05 not obtainable: Wikimedia returned HTTP 429 throughout the build)

shots.text: "The 'mystery of the Nok culture' hasn't been solved – but today we have a much clearer understanding of what that mystery actually is."
shots.credit: Nok seated figure · Louvre (70.1998.11.1) · Photo: Marie-Lan Nguyen, Public domain

shots.text: Great art – and, so far, no evidence of a great state.
shots.credit: Nok terracotta head · Cleveland Museum of Art (1995.21) · CC0
